Thirteen records name a dataset claim in `extends`. Every quote is verbatim from the cached retrieval of its own edition and within the per-source quotation budget that the dataset’s existing quotes have left; where the budget or the PDF text layer made a verbatim match uncheckable, the record uses an explicit paraphrase and its evidence note says why.
